t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Choose gnomes that have red in their colour to score well. Avoid gnomes with colours such as green and blue, instead go for gnomes with red, orange or purple colour

vb_textbox.text: The points seem to be awarded fairly randomly, however I followed the advice I was given beforehand and stuck to colours that had red in them, and that seemed to work well for me. So, choose the gnomes that have red in them, red, purple, orange etc. Between brown and pink, I naturally gravitated towards brown as I felt it gave me more points, but I think they were fairly similar.
